triples.tail_surface: Mount the preheated bearing (2250) carefully on the pump shaft (2200) at impeller side and push it firmly against the shaft shoulder. Let the bearing cool down!
triples.evidence_text: Mount the preheated bearing (2250) carefully on the pump shaft (2200) at impeller side and push it firmly against the shaft shoulder. Let the bearing cool down!

triples.tail_surface: Mount the preheated bearing (2260) carefully on the pump shaft at drive side and push it firmly against the shaft shoulder. Let the bearing cool down!
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装驱动侧预热轴承并冷却
triples.evidence_text: Mount the preheated bearing (2260) carefully on the pump shaft at drive side and push it firmly against the shaft shoulder. Let the bearing cool down!

triples.tail_surface: apply a small amount of grease at both sides of the bearings
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在轴承两侧涂抹少量润滑脂
triples.evidence_text: Pull the rubber closure rings gently aside and apply a small amount of grease at both sides of the bearings. Push the closure rings back in their correct position.

triples.tail_surface: Use a proper puller to remove the bearings from the pump shaft
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用专用拉拔器拆卸轴承
triples.evidence_text: Use a proper puller to remove the bearings from the pump shaft. Remove both the rubber closure rings (2390).

triples.tail_surface: protect the bearing at impeller side by mounting the laminated seal (2165)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装层压密封以保护叶轮侧轴承
triples.evidence_text: Mount the bearing cover (2115) at drive side and protect the bearing at impeller side by mounting the laminated seal (2165).
